Used unmodified to build the Windows installer. The compiler is a build-time
dependency, not an application runtime. Installer components retain their
upstream Inno Setup license; original application code remains AGPL-3.0-only.
See LICENSE.txt in this directory. No commercial license key is bundled.

that purchase is not strictly required. Non-commercial users are not requested
to purchase a license. Recheck https://jrsoftware.org/isorder.php when changing
